section: Microsoft Teams platform features: Teams Premium, Copilot agents, Room Remote and Teams Events
body:
AVI-SPL's Microsoft Teams page summarizes the Microsoft capabilities a customer gets when choosing Teams and Teams Rooms as the meeting platform. This brief covers the platform features the page describes; AVI-SPL's own services around Teams are a separate topic.

**The overall proposition**
The page groups Microsoft Teams Premium, Teams Rooms, Teams Phone, Copilot and Places as the set that enables more intelligent, inclusive and productive hybrid meetings, enhanced by AI, for people in the room and people working remotely.

**Microsoft Teams Premium**
Described as powering more personalized, intelligent and secure communication and collaboration. Additions to Teams named on the page: AI-powered recaps, advanced events, Microsoft Places, the Queues app, and more.

**Microsoft 365 Copilot AI-powered agents**
These help manage meetings, set follow-up tasks and overcome language barriers.
- **Facilitator agent**: takes notes, answers questions and moderates discussions according to the agenda or the goals that were defined. It gives a recap of key decisions and open questions halfway through and again at the close, takes notes in real time and assigns follow-up tasks.
- **Interpreter agent**: in Teams meetings, provides real-time speech-to-speech translation so participants can speak and listen in up to nine languages. It can be switched on at any time, and attendees may either simulate their own voice or pick a preset.

**Room Remote**
Room Remote in the Teams app lets participants control the camera, microphone, layout and settings of a shared device without interrupting the meeting. Requirements: a mobile device that is Bluetooth-enabled and has Teams installed, plus Room Remote switched on for the Teams Room system.

**Microsoft Teams Events**
Brings webinars and Town Halls into a single experience for creating and managing events, from small sessions to large broadcasts. The page lists:
- Live events for up to 10,000 interactive participants.
- Audience expansion up to 100,000 with Attendee Capacity Pack licenses.
- Engagement through Q&A, Polls and reactions.
- Integrated analytics and reporting to track performance.

AVI-SPL invites customers to work with it to design, deploy and scale a Microsoft Teams Events strategy.

**When to use this**
Use when a customer asks what Teams Premium adds, what the Copilot Facilitator and Interpreter agents do in meetings, how Room Remote works, or how large a Teams event can be.

**Not stated in this source**
Apart from the Attendee Capacity Pack licenses for the larger audience, these sections do not say which licence each feature needs, and they give no prices.
